title: Notes on gotchas while migrating 35kb preprompts from Opus to self-hosted Ollama
summary: Technical notes documenting the challenges and solutions when migrating 35kb of large system prompts from commercial APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) to self-hosted Ollama, covering practical gotchas encountered during the transition.
problem_solved: Reduces dependency on expensive commercial LLM APIs by enabling self-hosted alternatives while maintaining compatibility with existing large prompt workflows.
why_valuable: Provides real-world migration insights and practical workarounds that can save developers significant time when moving from commercial to self-hosted LLM infrastructure.
